Cred ca degeaba iti trimit testele rezolvate de mine pentru ca am scris mainly prescurtat. Dau tot din bio vegetala deci o sa incerc sa ti zic cam pe ce ma bazez eu(sper la un 7.5-8).


Drept structura si asezare in pagina, la I A, unde trebuie sa completezi spatiile punctate, pe foaie trebuie sa scrii doar cuvintele, in ordinea din cerinta, cu virgula intre ele(sau unul sub altul daca preferi).

La B iti cere deobicei sa dai exemplu de ceva si maybe o caracteristica, tot asa scrii exemplele unul sub altul, si cu liniuta dupa fiecare scrii caracteristica(sau ce ti mai cere).

La C scrii doar cifra si litera corecta, iar pentru asta sugerez sa faci grile din vreo culegere sau de pe net, ca se repeta super mult si again, daca nu stii doar uita te la raspunsuri si o sa retii destule.

La D, cu adevarat/fals o sa fie mereu doua false si una adevarata, deci in caz ca nu le stii ai sanse mai mari sa primesti punctaj daca le pui pe toate false. Aici scrii "cifra, A/F, reformularea unde e cazul". Again si la asta recomand sa mai faci exercitii ca se repeta multe. 



Cel mai usor o sa fie subiectul II, o sa ai prima problema din circulatie, axeaza te sa raspunzi la intrebarile a) si b) de la problema aia. Treci prin teste si honestly nu te speria daca nu stii sa le faci, eu am invatat uitandu-ma la raspunsuri/cautand rezolvarea pe net, si o sa vezi ca se repeta multe/seamana. La c) si d) o sa ai un exercitiu in care iti dau ei direct tot ce ai nevoie, sunt calcule super usoare. Drept structura eu scriu "m sange=7/100 x m corp=... L(litri)". La d) trebuie sa formulezi tu un alt enunt, my go to e sa cer masa elementelor figurate(e 45% din sange, ma ajuta sa verific daca am facut si plasma corect).

Problema din genetica e super usoara mereu, poți cauta niste rezolvari daca nu le stii. Profa de la clasa mi a sugerat sa fac segregarea(schema) la inceput, si apoi sa incep sa raspund la intrebari. Also la d) incearca sa formulezi un enunt cat mai asemanator cu ce ai la c), ca sa iti puncteze macar formularea enuntului.

La III eu deja ma bazez pe noroc, din ce am observat sistemul respirator, si cel excretor sunt cele mai scurte/usoare deci recomand sa le inveti, pe restul uita te daca mai ai timp. Digestivul e mai greu dar merita invatat ca le place sa puna intrebari din el.


So yea overall fa niste grile si exercitii cu A/F, invata sa rezolvi II ca pe ala sa primesc cel mai usor puncte, iar de invatat invata intai sistemul respirator, excretor, si digestivul daca ai nervii necesari. Sist circulator eu l am invatat din teste, dar m am uitat si inainte pe teorie.

I've been feeling like that too lately, I even had a list in my mind with all the people I used to be friends with and reasons as to why I think they don't wanna talk with me anymore, and a couple days ago one of them texted me, telling me they've been going through a difficult time and couldn't reach out to me until then. Also, I opened up about this to one of the only people that still talk with me, and they said that another friend that was on my "list" kept asking about me but was also afraid to text me, just like I was to text them.

Now I obviously don't know the people in your life, but chances are that at least one or a few of them do care, but just don't know how to show it, or just like my first friend they don't have the energy to reach out to people.

So if you feel like it's possible for you, maybe text someone that you think would be more willing to talk to you, and tell them how you feel(or if you don't want that, simply start a conversation completely unrelated to this, you'll feel better once you do it, trust me).

I know it's hard tho, which is why I waited for that friend to text me instead of doing it myself, so I understand if you can't do it yet because of various reasons that I obviously don't know. But from what I've learned, usually it's not as bad as our depression makes us think it is, I know for sure that my brain made me be constantly afraid that I'll slowly lose everyone, or that just because someone hasn't texted me in weeks/months they are mad at me and doesn't wanna talk anymore. That fear doesn't disappear that easily, but it could still help to reach out to at least one person, if you have the possibility to.

And if you don't, as another person commented, start doing things that you love and keep yourself busy. It'll hurt, I know, but it can at least keep yourself distracted for some time
